title: brisk host request
description: Printed on stdout by `brisk assess --backend host --format json`. The harness sends `state` and `questions` unchanged to its decision model (for Amp: amp.ai.decide({ model: 'typesafe/jev', state, questions })), then writes a host-answers document and runs `brisk assess --answers file.json` with the same other flags. `floor_assessment` is the rules-only result, to show when answering fails.

request_id.description: Hash of state and questions; copy it into the answers

model.description: Decision model the calibration expects, e.g. "typesafe/jev"

state.description: String or JSON object, at most 50,000 characters when serialised
